findings.title: Production repository is world-writable
findings.evidence: ALC-007A: /root/synapse changed from mode 0777 UID/GID 1000 to root:root 0750; verified runtime consumers retained access.
findings.recommended_remediation: Change ownership and least-privilege mode after path attribution
findings.acceptance_criteria: No world-writable production tree; services retain required access

findings.title: Backend and PostgreSQL published on all interfaces
findings.evidence: ALC-007A: backend 8000 and PostgreSQL 5433 loopback-only; UFW active inbound-deny; external 8000/5433/3010/3011 unreachable.
findings.recommended_remediation: Bind to loopback/private network and enforce deny-by-default firewall
findings.safe_verification_method: external inventory plus local listener check
findings.rollback_consideration: Restore prior bindings from versioned config
findings.acceptance_criteria: Only approved ingress ports externally reachable

findings.title: Legacy preview runs as root from production checkout
findings.evidence: allchemist-web-preview.service User=root and /root/synapse paths
findings.user_business_impact: Restart can mutate production build tree
findings.recommended_remediation: Retire 3010 after parity or package immutable non-root release
findings.rollback_consideration: Keep current unit until proven rollback
findings.acceptance_criteria: No runtime executes from production checkout; rollback tested

findings.title: No authoritative Alembic revision tree
findings.evidence: alembic dependency/wheel exists; no alembic.ini or versions tree
findings.user_business_impact: Schema changes cannot be ordered or reproduced
findings.recommended_remediation: Adopt Alembic with stamped audited baseline and forward/rollback policy
findings.rollback_consideration: restore isolated snapshot; production change plan separate
findings.acceptance_criteria: Clean DB reaches expected schema; drift check and rollback pass

findings.title: Environment databases are not separated
findings.evidence: compose defines one synapse DB; production host also used by tests historically
findings.user_business_impact: Tests or preview can affect production
findings.recommended_remediation: Separate clusters or instances, roles, credentials and network policies
findings.acceptance_criteria: Each environment has unique endpoint/role/database and CI uses ephemeral DB

findings.title: Tenant keys are incomplete and not database-enforced globally
findings.evidence: school tables have school_id FKs; user_progress, device_registry and content tables lack tenant key; no RLS evidence
findings.recommended_remediation: Tenant-scoped schema, composite keys, RLS or mandatory policy layer with tests
findings.rollback_consideration: feature flag and reversible policy rollout
findings.acceptance_criteria: Every tenant-owned row has enforced tenant scope and cross-tenant tests

findings.title: Mutable JSON state remains on protected filesystem candidates
findings.evidence: user_state and security history files exist in production; consumers documented
findings.recommended_remediation: Move transactional identity/state to PostgreSQL and append-only audit events to audit storage
findings.safe_verification_method: fixture migration in isolated DB with counts/hashes only
findings.estimated_implementation_phase: retain encrypted snapshot and dual-read rollback window
findings.rollback_consideration: No authoritative mutable JSON; consumers use managed stores
findings.acceptance_criteria: runtime path metadata; ALC-003 runtime report
findings.source_references: user_state and security history files exist in production; consumers documented

findings.title: No Redis or durable job runtime exists
findings.evidence: no Redis/queue container; REDIS_URL only configuration name
findings.affected_components: rate limits, notifications, imports, scheduled tasks
findings.recommended_remediation: Use Redis only for ephemeral cache/rate limits/locks and durable queue metadata backed by PostgreSQL
findings.rollback_consideration: disable workers and replay durable job ledger
findings.acceptance_criteria: Ephemeral data reconstructs; durable jobs survive Redis loss

findings.title: No managed object-storage boundary
findings.evidence: content packs/assets/releases/backups are filesystem/repository paths; no bucket runtime
findings.recommended_remediation: S3-compatible versioned buckets with per-class lifecycle, signed URLs, validation and CDN
findings.safe_verification_method: isolated bucket policy and lifecycle tests
findings.acceptance_criteria: Versioning, encryption, tenant prefixes, malware validation and restore tested
findings.source_references: repository paths and object readiness docs

findings.title: Password baseline exists but complete account defense is unproven
findings.evidence: UI states minimum 8; auth code has token rotation/revocation and OTP limits; compromised-password, MFA and robust lockout evidence absent
findings.recommended_remediation: Argon2id/bcrypt policy, breached-password screening, progressive delay, MFA for privileged roles and recovery controls
findings.safe_verification_method: isolated auth tests and code review
findings.acceptance_criteria: Policy enforced server-side; privileged MFA; rotation/recovery tests pass

findings.title: Secrets management and rotation are not evidenced
findings.evidence: many provider secret variable names; env values intentionally not read; no vault/rotation evidence
findings.affected_components: DB, JWT, AI, payment, push, admin credentials
findings.recommended_remediation: Managed secret store, workload identity where possible, rotation inventory and audited break-glass
findings.prohibited_unsafe_verification: print or rotate production secrets in audit
findings.acceptance_criteria: All secrets inventoried by name/owner/expiry; rotations tested without disclosure

findings.title: Role catalogue exceeds demonstrated enforcement
findings.evidence: UI and contracts mention many roles; selected admin permissions exist; full endpoint/object matrix absent
findings.affected_components: student, parent, teacher, school admin, QA, support, finance, sysadmin, owner
findings.user_business_impact: Unauthorized functions or data may be exposed
findings.recommended_remediation: Central policy service with deny-by-default permission and object predicates; separation of duties
findings.acceptance_criteria: All roles have explicit permissions and negative tests; impersonation audited

findings.title: Publication workflow exists but immutability and override controls are incomplete
findings.evidence: content_blocks and content_qa_events exist with statuses/events; no immutable release/version enforcement evidence
findings.recommended_remediation: Versioned drafts, two-person approval for blocking/safety findings, immutable release manifests and signed rollback
findings.acceptance_criteria: No mutable published version; overrides require reason and second approver
findings.source_references: DB catalog and content endpoint source

findings.title: AI data governance is not approved
findings.evidence: provider abstraction/config exists; no complete PII/minor retention, prompt audit or model provenance policy
findings.user_business_impact: Uncontrolled minor data use and unreliable answers
findings.recommended_remediation: Redaction gateway, minimal retention, provider allowlist, model/version provenance, safety classifiers, uncertainty and human handoff
findings.safe_verification_method: synthetic prompts and policy tests only
findings.prohibited_unsafe_verification: send real minors data or adversarial production prompts
findings.rollback_consideration: provider kill switch and offline fallback
findings.acceptance_criteria: Approved DPIA; no prohibited PII; outputs traceable and safety-tested

findings.title: No end-to-end observability stack is evidenced
findings.evidence: health endpoints and operational docs exist; no Prometheus/OTel/error-tracker runtime
findings.recommended_remediation: OpenTelemetry instrumentation, Prometheus/Grafana, Loki, Sentry, Alertmanager and synthetic probes
findings.rollback_consideration: disable exporters and preserve local logs
findings.acceptance_criteria: SLO dashboards, alerts, traces and redaction tests pass

findings.title: Backup presence lacks independent restore proof
findings.evidence: backup scripts/status/history exist; no verified current full restore evidence
findings.recommended_remediation: Encrypted immutable off-site 3-2-1 backups and scheduled isolated restore drills
findings.safe_verification_method: restore into isolated network and verify schema/manifests
findings.acceptance_criteria: RPO/RTO met in timestamped restore drill without production access

findings.title: Offline data lifecycle and shared-device controls are incomplete
findings.evidence: AsyncStorage/SQLite/offline queues and logout cleanup exist; encryption, conflict policy and corrupt-cache recovery not fully evidenced; no web service worker
findings.user_business_impact: Lost progress or data left on shared devices
findings.recommended_remediation: Classify local fields, encrypt sensitive storage, user-scoped cache, deterministic conflict/version policy and logout wipe
findings.acceptance_criteria: Logout wipes sensitive state; conflict/corruption/shared-device tests pass

findings.title: Notification preferences and token governance are incomplete
findings.evidence: push registration and sound/haptic preferences exist; token retention, consent, tenant audience and revocation evidence incomplete
findings.security_data_impact: Device token and minor privacy risk
findings.recommended_remediation: Per-user/device consent, tenant-scoped audiences, token expiry/revocation and server preference source of truth
findings.acceptance_criteria: Consent/preferences honored across devices; revoked tokens unusable

findings.title: Database transport encryption is disabled
findings.evidence: PostgreSQL SHOW ssl = off; port 5433 exposed
findings.user_business_impact: Credentials/data travel unencrypted outside container network
findings.recommended_remediation: Private network binding plus TLS verification for any cross-host DB traffic
findings.acceptance_criteria: No public DB listener; TLS required and verified where traffic leaves host namespace
findings.source_references: read-only SHOW ssl and listener metadata

findings.title: Release and rollback are only partially reproducible
findings.evidence: canonical preview immutable layout exists; production backend/legacy release is compose/checkout coupled and rollback evidence incomplete
findings.recommended_remediation: Immutable versioned releases, manifests, health gates and one-command reviewed rollback
findings.acceptance_criteria: Cold deploy and rollback reproduce without production checkout
